This is my plot of nearly one hectare, and I plant maize together with some cowpea between the rows like my father taught me. I want to use small fertilizer because maize needs it to grow well here in the middle belt, but money is tight so I will only buy one or two bags of NPK and maybe some urea if I can. I keep some goats and chickens, so I will spread their droppings on the field before the rains come heavy. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year — I will use the seed I saved from last harvest, and my wife and I will do most of the work ourselves, hiring only a few people for weeding when the grass becomes too much.
